title: Putrabadhu
desc: The members of a joint family go through various ups and downs in their lives and attempt to stay together despite all the odds stacked against them.

title: Pabitra Papi
desc: To teach Bhola a lesson, Rajib marries his sister, deceives them out of their land, and has Bhola imprisoned. However, Bhola vows to seek justice and avenge the wrongs done to his family.

title: Sathihara
desc: Musicians Anuradha and Jeet fall in love and marry, but their relationship is tested when Anuradha's thriving career begins to overshadow Jeet's ambitions.

title: Satya Mithya
desc: Worried to see his daughter Rita in low spirits, Mr Chowdhury decides to take her to Dhaka. There, he hires Raju, a responsible young man, whom Rita falls in love with.

title: Bandie
desc: Unable to conceive an heir, Maharaja Brajbhan and his wife are forced to abdicate the throne for his cousin, Vikram. Chaos ensues when Vikram learns that the queen is pregnant and decides to kill her.
